entries.name: WP2 plug-in foundations
entries.why: Measured growth of the start (plan allowance 1.0 KB): the emit sites in main.ts and hud-combat.ts, the sending end of the event bus, the features loader with its one retry, bossApproach, and addPhrases in i18n.ts. The bus, the services and every feature load after Start.

entries.name: WP6 toy finish
entries.why: Measured growth of the start (the plan's 0.3 KB was an estimate): the five colour steps, the ramp-colour shader patch and the icon/mirror swap in toon.ts, the neutral light steps under a cool sun, the gloss in look.ts, the look switch, and in crop-cards.ts (world chunk, loaded before Start) the bake at the camera pitch, the footprint cap and the centring of lopsided crops. Two slimming passes brought it from 485 to 443 bytes; the rest would mean cutting one of these.
